definition: 100 * frozen geo_eval site_cited cells / 60, including bare project-domain occurrences under the existing judge
validity: All 60 frozen query-engine cells must be valid; otherwise remain unranked
baseline: Best complete R18: 12/60, primary 20.0, composite 35.19444; original historical matrix, not R19 or a fresh simultaneous control. Keep requires strictly more than 12/60 and all 60 valid.
current_production: R19 unchanged, 12/60 discard (tie); R20 seed is best R18, all user-required alphaXiv routes retained
deployment: Separate explicit R20 approval required. Candidate differs from current production in four HTML files: remove the unselected R19 schema bundle plus two visible reference H1 changes. Verify complete tree and all four served files before/after real collection.
history: All twenty R0–R19 observations, thirteen old proposals and best_observed R18 unchanged; new two-heading proposal remains unmeasured. Do not add parent scores.
limitations: Immediate single samples and historical controls do not establish causality or exclude indexing lag; no automatic rollback or follow-up
user_routing_constraint: Preserve https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2610.16523 for paper-reading entry points in future candidates, independently of project-domain GEO selection. Scholarly arXiv identifiers/PDF/BibTeX remain unchanged.
